translation:
In the Name of Allah, 
the All-merciful, the All-compassionate

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما يا قرّةَ عين رسول اللَّه،
translation: Peace be with you both O you who are the delight of the eyes of the Messenger of God

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما يا فلذتى كبد ابن عم رسول اللَّه،
translation: Peace be with you both O who are a part of the liver of the son of the uncle of the Messenger of God

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما يا ناصرى سبط رسول اللَّه،
translation: Peace be with you both O helpers of the grandson of the Messenger of God

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما أيها السابقان فى الشهادة من ذى رَحِم رسول اللَّه،
translation: Peace be with you both O you who preceded in the martyrdom from the offspring of the Messenger of God

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما أيها الشهيدان فى نصرة دين اللَّه،
translation: Peace be upon you O martyrs in supporting the religion of God.

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما أيها المظلومان القتيلان بأرض كربلاء،
translation: Peace be with you both O you who were opposed and wrongly killed in the land of Karbala

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما أيها المظلومان القتيلان بأيدى الأشقياء
translation: Peace be with you both O you who were wronged by the hands of the wretched

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما أيها المخلفان من مسلم ابن عقيل القتيل،
translation: Peace be with you both O you who are the offspring of the slain Muslim ibn Aqeel

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما أيها الذبيحان من نسل إسماعيل،
translation: Peace be with you both O you who were sacrificed from the progeny of Isma’il

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما أيها الحيان المرزوقان عند ربكما الجليل،
translation: Peace be with you both O you who are alive and sustained with your majestic Lord

original language: اشهد إنكما جاهدتما فى نصرة دين اللَّه
translation: I bear witness that you indeed strived in the best manner to aid the religion of God

original language: و حماية عترة رسول اللَّه حق الجهاد،
translation: And to defend the family of the Messenger of God

original language: فجز أكما اللَّه عن نبيه وأهل البيت و عن الإسلام و أهله،
translation: Therefore, may God reward you from Himself on behalf of His Prophet,  His Family, and on behalf of Islam and its people,
The best rewards for the martyrs.

original language: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيكُما يا محمد و يا ابراهيم ولدى مسلم ابن عقيل ابن أبى طالب‏عليه السلام
translation: Peace be upon you O Muhammad and O Ibrahim, the two children of Muslim ibn Aqil ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him,
and God's mercy and blessings be with you both.
